cohort: The study included a large cohort of Brazilian males with idiopathic intellectual disability, from which two unrelated sporadic individuals with syndromic ID carrying unique overlapping duplications were identified.
finding: The study highlights the importance of microduplications at Xp11.22, specifically involving HUWE1, in the etiology of intellectual disability, even in sporadic cases, and provides new clinical and molecular insights into these genomic rearrangements.
